literal: Duty to do, a person "I will not cease" saying, than the greatness, eminence possessing thing there is not.
translation: There is no glory greater than the greatness of a person who says, "I will not cease from doing my duty."
modern: தன் கடமையைச் செய்து முடிக்க 'நான் ஒருபோதும் ஓயமாட்டேன்' என்று ஒருவன் கூறும் பெருமையை விடச் சிறந்த பெருமை வேறொன்றும் இல்லை.
explanation: The couplet emphasizes the supreme value of relentless dedication to one's duty. The word 'கருமம்' refers to the necessary action or duty one must perform to uplift one's family or community. The phrase 'கைதூவேன்' means 'I will not cease' or 'I will not rest my hands', capturing the spirit of tireless effort. The verse declares that there is no glory ('பீடு') that surpasses the greatness of such unwavering commitment.
